review.method: acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the production cs_content::scrapbook::discover + resource_names + declare + audit chain over that installation (the consumer trace), the production baseline's scrapbook_item rows (the identity cross-check, produced by a different code path over the same member), a byte-level scan of ASSETS/SCRIPTS/RESOURCE.H and ASSETS/SCRIPTS/RESRC1.H (the independent check that the 12 unresolved TitleResID names are defined in neither shipped header), rustc and Cargo.lock; validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. Implementer mutation probe on this branch: replacing the declared catalog with an empty one fails five of six synthetic acceptance tests — the uncovered-record error-path test correctly stays green because it pins the build's refusal, not the catalog's contents. LIMITATION: Every declared entry's `unlock` is `Resolved::Unknown`: the table's `Objective` column is parsed but its meaning is unmeasured, so the declared catalog unlocks nothing — the book displays, nothing in it is earned. Affected content: all 461 entries' unlock paths and the hidden-page and reward claims of F47 and F42. Resolving task: **#774 / F47-D.2**, which measures the field's rule. LIMITATION: No declared entry has a replay link: the table documents no mission field, so the original's replay control exists but its target cannot be read from the table. Affected content: every replay launch in F47-C. Resolving task: **#774 / F47-D.2** and the campaign bindings for the mission identity. LIMITATION: No `EntryKind::Memento` is declared: the table holds no memento record, and `EntryKind` stays `Page` for every record because no measured discriminator separates articles, photos and trophies. Affected content: the cabin memento choice (spec F47 non-negotiable 5). Resolving tasks: **#774 / F47-D.2** and the cabin screen work. LIMITATION: `EntryVisibility::Shown` is declared, not measured: whether the original hides locked entries is unmeasured, so the declared state is the visible-but-never-unlocked one the table proves. Affected content: how every locked entry presents in the scrapbook screen. Resolving task: **#774 / F47-D.2**. LIMITATION: Twelve `TitleResID` names are dead references in the shipped table — they appear in no `*.H` member of either installed container (the byte-level scan in this report's harness re-verifies it): `IDS_SB_08_01_MANIFEST_T`, `IDS_SB_09_01_TELEGRAM1_T`, `IDS_SB_09_01_TELEGRAM2_T`, `IDS_SB_12_01_FENCE_T`, `IDS_SB_14_01_TELEGRAM3_T`, `IDS_SB_16_01_SPARKSNOTE_T`, `IDS_SB_21_01_BILLBILL_T`, `IDS_SB_21_01_CONLETTER_T`, `IDS_SB_21_01_CRAWNOTE_T`, `IDS_SB_22_01_COMICLETTER_T`, `IDS_SB_22_01_RICHLETTER_T`, `IDS_SB_24_01_CRAWNOTE2_T`. Their entries keep the name in the title id's key and show no title. Affected content: those twelve items' titles. Resolving task: none — the data is measured; the original could not resolve them either. LIMITATION: `TextResID` has no slot in `ScrapbookEntry`'s schema and is not carried: the schema the stage must fill has no body-text field, so 78 records' body-text names are parsed but not projected. Affected content: the article bodies the scrapbook shows. Resolving task: a follow-up that extends the schema or joins the text table. LIMITATION: 167 of the 461 items name a picture (`Snap_*`) that exists nowhere in the installation's containers; their entries carry `image: None`, never a placeholder. Affected content: those items' artwork. Resolving task: a capture stage for runtime snapshots, if the owner wants them. LIMITATION: The empty `TitleResID` spelling (four records) is declared as the same `string_resource/0` the `0` spelling produces — both are the table's null-resource spellings; the choice is recorded here because the schema cannot carry an absent title. Affected content: those four records' titles.
